symptom: Pump does not start The pump does not start when power is applied.
failure_mode: Blown motor fuse The 10 A motor fuse is blown.
corrective_action: Replace the 10 A motor fuse Replace the blown motor fuse and restart the pump. Replace the 10 A motor fuse, close the fuse holder, and restart the pump.

symptom: Low discharge pressure Discharge pressure is below the expected value.
failure_mode: Clogged inlet filter The inlet filter is clogged and restricts flow.
corrective_action: Remove and wash the inlet filter Clean the clogged inlet filter and verify discharge pressure. Remove the inlet filter, wash it with clean water, reinstall it, and run a pressure test.
corrective_action_name: Remove and wash the inlet filter
